en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a wide body of water under a cloudy sky. Long wooden piers or breakwaters extend into the water from the right side, with a few small figures walking along them and a solitary tree near the shore. The scene appears calm and natural, likely an inlet or harbor entrance. In the upper right corner there is printed text in Swedish: "Södra inloppet, Vänersborg."
